authorization: Add two model cells: claude-sonnet-5-5 and gpt-6.1-sol. Two separate budgets up to 25 USD each on top of the old 35 USD. Five-call calibrations before full cell; report projection if above 25 USD.
budgetScope: New model cell only; excludes original 35 USD lane budget and preserves old holds
calibration: Exactly five answered calls from sealed PILOT prefix in sealed contestant order. Cost only; no prompt, pool, parser, criteria or contract tuning. Partial calibration job may remain as raw cached calls.
projection: Per-contestant five-call mean times 301 comparisons. Primary calls per comparison use pre-existing completed Flash Lite runtime rate; promptfoo uses two. Hard budget prevents overspend regardless of projection.
statistics: Unchanged stats.py summarize: nominal exact two-sided McNemar plus language-stratified request-cluster 95% CI; positive results await family multiplicity handling.
transportPolicy: Never resubmit a returned answer. Frozen core single schema re-ask is retained and charged. HTTP 402 stops immediately and releases only proven rejection holds. Transport failures retain uncertain holds.
thinkingCap: Total output including thinking is 4096. Native Sonnet additionally requests MAX_THINKING_TOKENS=2048; adaptive reasoning may ignore that fixed budget. Output-cap losses are reported.
isolation: Empty cell runtime/empty directory; explicit frozen judge system prompt; no tools, settings sources, MCP config, session persistence or slash commands; medium effort; native retries disabled.

runtimeAmendment.reason: Sonnet one-hour cache writes are charged at 4 USD/M versus 2 USD/M uncached. Disable prompt caching only, leaving prompt, contestant input, medium setting and cap unchanged. Sol meter accounts for observed input_tokens_details.cache_write_tokens at 2.50 USD/M.
runtimeAmendment.authorization: Owner permits runtime-only fix projecting at most 45 USD, five fresh calibration calls, then full run under 45 USD hard stop. Otherwise park as owner budget decision.

recoveryAmendment.authorization: Owner authorizes GPT-6.1 cap 32 USD including holds, Sonnet cap 45 USD including holds, and one fresh cycle up to 3 submissions each for 12 exhausted no-answer calls. Two consecutive connection-class failures stop all new calls. Any connection failure mid-TEST stops before any TEST retry.

networkSupervisionAmendment.authorization: Owner instructs three successful probes spaced one minute apart for both providers before resuming, concurrency 2 per model, keep circuit break, wait 10 minutes after a new break then repeat probes, park after three such stops in one hour, TEST only after 20 consecutive healthy DEV calls. Answers, holds and caps unchanged.
networkSupervisionAmendment.stopCountScope: New stops after the three-probe policy begins; prior failures remain in history.
networkSupervisionAmendment.healthyDevScope: Per model in current healthy runtime epoch; no extra DEV calls or re-answering allowed.
networkSupervisionAmendment.midTestNetworkPolicy: First connection failure stops all new submissions; tell owner before any TEST retry.

unlimitedRecoveryAmendment.authorization: Owner requires ten healthy probes 30 seconds apart on the active provider; concurrency 2, one model at a time; three consecutive connection-class failures pause 600 seconds then repeat the gate. Unlimited missing-only transport recovery, including the 12 exhausted logical calls. No answered call is resent. Settle no-answer holds only when explicit provider usage confirms zero tokens. TEST requires 20 consecutive healthy DEV calls; no final result while transport-missing items remain. Owner removes 16:00 UTC cutoff for these two cells because of host network pause, no TEST result seen.
unlimitedRecoveryAmendment.cutoffReason: Host network pause, no TEST result seen. Schedule amendment only.
supersedes: recoveryAmendment maximumTotalSubmissionsPerKey and mid-TEST owner-word requirement

native503RuntimeFix.reason: Native Claude CLI reports HTTP 503 inside its error text without a separate httpStatus field. Recognize that representation in the same connection-class circuit breaker. Existing healthy run drained before edit; no TEST call yet. No prompt, input, model setting, scoring, sealed order or cap change. Resume through the existing ten-probe gate.

quotaOrderingAmendment.reason: Sonnet native session quota rejected one call with explicit zero tokens at 16:28 UTC, reset reported 16:50 UTC. Park Sonnet without treating rejection as judge failure. Run GPT-6.1 alone through its ten-probe gate while Sonnet waits. Preserve first stop reason if an in-flight sibling later reports generic shutdown.
quotaOrderingAmendment.sonnetResumption: Await owner reply on missing-only quota recovery; no answered call may be resent
